svg.title: Georeferencer - implemented application architecture
svg.desc: The browser and CLI use a local Python pipeline. SQLite stores library results and history. Local caches share source documents and model responses. JSONL events and usage feed the debug UI. There is no durable job queue.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:

Upload, results, evidence, debug
